title: Hatsune Miku — Wonder☆Christmas〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Event: On This Holy Night, I Sing

rows.Line: Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
La-di-da-di-da♪
As usual, we had a really fun performance!

rows.Speaker: Plushie A
rows.Line: Yeah! It was great! Let's finish putting the props away so we can go talk about it with everyone!

rows.Speaker: Plushie B
rows.Line: Okay! Let's do it!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh, is someone waiting outside?
Is that...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It's Nene. Why's she not coming in?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Oh, maybe it's because she still feels shy around the plushies?)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Well, let's make her more comfortable☆)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Little ones, you go and play.
I'll take care of the rest♪

rows.Speaker: Plushie A
rows.Line: Wait, really?

rows.Speaker: Plushie B
rows.Line: Yay! Thanks, Miku!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yup! No problem!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Nene! It's just me here now!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh! Um...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
How are you, Nene?
Is there something you want to talk about?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Um...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I just wanted to tell you that we finished the last of our Christmas show performances and that they all went well.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That's great! And thank you for coming over to tell me about it!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And what about the contest?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: We managed to beat our rivals this round.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But they still lead in total points, so we have to do really well during our next performance to win.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That's great! I'll be cheering for you!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thanks.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Miku...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: The first time you visited SEKAI, you spent the whole time hiding behind Robo-Nene...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But now you're here talking to me face to face☆

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehehe! It makes me very happy♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Really...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Huh? What's wrong, Nene?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Um, well...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
There's no rush!
You can tell me whenever you like.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Okay, well...
I've been wondering about this for some time...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: This world was created based on Tsukasa's feelings, right?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You and KAITO have been inviting us here to see your shows, so that Tsukasa would remember what his true feelings were, I guess...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yup, that's correct.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So this is what I don't get...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Tsukasa's already discovered his true feelings, and I'm just performing in the same troupe as him so...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Why do you and KAITO care about me at all?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe, that's simple! It's because we want to see you blossom as an actress!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh... That's it?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But you do so much for me and encourage me every time I visit...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It's not that I'm worried about Tsukasa getting annoyed with me getting so much support from you, but I feel like you're spoiling me with this being his SEKAI and all...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: We're absolutely not, Nene!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And besides, you have a connection to SEKAI too!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Tsukasa's wish of bringing joy to everyone with your shows is also your wish!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Tsukasa also needs you, Emu and Rui to create the shows he dreams about!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You can't make great shows alone after all!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Don't you think so too, Nene? Don't you need your friends to create really special performances?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yes, I do...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Keep coming to SEKAI whenever you like!
I want to talk to you more and more♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Come for rehearsals, shows or just to hang out! You're always welcome here and promise not to be a stranger!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I promise...
Thanks, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Next time, I'll drop by just for fun.
I'll bring Emu along too.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
That'll be great☆
I'll be looking forward to it♪
